scope: R6 two-pass drain/reclaim permit, R5 one-line-at-a-time durable invalidation, and existing R2/R1 descriptor write transport only.

carriers.name: R5 reclaim SourceCandidate
fields: R1 write request or final write-data

line_invalidation.participant_rule: all currently allocated lanes in one selected descriptor line; nonparticipants remain FREE with current generation
line_invalidation.free_rule: only matching durable R1 terminal advances participants and frees their allocator bits
line_invalidation.address_rule: logical descriptor_line_index through opaque core address_ref; no HBM mapping

environment_assumptions: after a terminal and before identical identity wrap reuse, no old response remains possible
accepted external R1 request eventually receives one terminal response for progress only
